attributes.name: aria-labelledby
attributes.values: IDREF of the title; otherwise aria-label

keyboard.action: Move to the next tabbable element inside the drawer, wrapping from last to first.
Move to the previous tabbable element inside the drawer, wrapping from first to last.

focus.exit: Escape, the close control, or a press on the backdrop.
focus.restore: To the element that opened the drawer.

variants: non-modal (persistent side panel: no trap, a complementary landmark instead of a dialog)
data.notes: Keyboard contract is exactly dialog-modal (bindings repeated from that APG page). Not direction-sensitive for keys. The side must be logical: "start" is the right edge in RTL, and the swipe-to-close gesture travels toward that edge. Base UI exposes swipe direction as data attributes; we derive it from side and direction.
